en-US.longDescription: Navicat for SQLite is an exceptional and comprehensive GUI tool that provides a complete set of functions for easy navigation and customization. Its powerful query editor includes syntax highlighting and code completion, while its flexible import and export options significantly streamline the data manipulation process. You can also visually design and manage database structures, and engage our built-in BI tools to facilitate insightful data analysis and reporting.
